name: io.github.bilalnaseer/google-gsc-mcp
description: Google Search Console MCP server: search analytics, sitemaps and URL inspection.

environmentVariables.name: WSP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth Client ID from your own Google Cloud project (Desktop app client).

environmentVariables.name: WSP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth Client secret that belongs to WSP_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: WSP_OAUTH_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a downloaded OAuth client JSON file (alternative to WSP_CLIENT_ID and WSP_CLIENT_SECRET).

environmentVariables.name: WSP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a service account JSON key (for automation and teams).

environmentVariables.name: WSP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable write tools (add/remove websites and sitemaps). Off by default.
